primary_claim.exact_statement: For two binary outputs with independent per-molecule death rate 1, single-unit births, arbitrary full-count causal feedback, and a shared instantaneous aggregate birth-intensity cap B, stationary marginals P(N1=1)=P(N2=1)=1/10 are feasible iff B >= (6-sqrt(34))/(sqrt(34)-5), approximately 0.203439. The lower bound is attained by symmetric state-dependent birth rates described in CYCLE2_REPORT.md.
assumptions: Each occupied output molecule dies independently at rate 1.
A birth adds one molecule to exactly one output; no bursts.
Birth intensity is zero for an output already at its cap 1.
At every state and time, the sum of accepted birth intensities is at most B.
The objective and constraints are stationary long-run occupancy and birth-flow averages.
The controller has access to the full two-output count state.
primary_claim.status: exact model derivation with constructive attainment; novelty unknown
primary_claim.novelty_boundary: The example refutes independent scalar-capacity plus mean-cost checks for the specified shared-cap process. General controlled birth/death average optimization by LP is established queue-control/CTMDP prior art. No priority search has established novelty of the numeric two-output boundary. The model is not a direct biological validation.

secondary_claim.exact_statement: For finite capped species counts with single-unit controlled births, fixed positive linear death rates, and a shared per-state birth-intensity cap, stationary joint-threshold optimization under linear average production or state/action costs is exactly a finite occupation-flow LP. Feasible birth flows z_{x,i} and state masses pi_x obey statewise shared-cap constraints and global balance; conversely u_i(x)=z_{x,i}/pi_x realizes every feasible stationary flow pair.
assumptions: Births are single-unit and unavailable at each species cap.
Death intensity for species i is gamma_i*N_i with gamma_i>0.
Reliability and costs are stationary long-run averages linear in state/action occupation.
Any dynamically evolving resource/controller state that changes rates or costs is included in the state.
secondary_claim.status: proved specialization; general method subsumed by established CTMDP occupation-LP literature
secondary_claim.novelty_boundary: The occupation-flow reduction is standard CTMDP/queue-control mathematics; the specialization is an exact modeling/analysis tool, not a general new optimization principle. Censored observations make the full-state LP an information relaxation; dynamic hidden resources must be added to the state.

literature_status.queue_control: Established prior art. Serfozo 1981 treats controlled birth/death processes and queues under average reward and discusses a linear program; Guo, Huang, and Song 2012 establish equivalent constrained-average CTMDP LPs for history-dependent policies and illustrate with a controlled birth/death system.
literature_status.molecular_feedback: Primary literature already studies antithetic controller architecture and noise reduction under resource competition (Chakravarty, Zhang, Tian 2024), using stochastic simulation/FDT rather than this hard-cap stationary joint-threshold LP.
literature_status.spatial_gene_optimization: Resource-constrained optimization of spatial gene-expression patterns is already studied (Sokolowski et al. 2025, PNAS), with a positional-information objective and production/degradation/resource-utilization constraints; it is distinct from the exact stochastic threshold model here.
literature_status.negative_novelty_claim: No exhaustive novelty search was conducted; absence of this exact formula from the checked sources is not evidence of priority.

charged: Accepted unit births, with average flux sum_{x,i} z_{x,i}.
Shared peak rate B at every count state and time.
Any explicitly added state-running or state/action controller cost.
not_charged_unless_augmented: Ribosome, RNA polymerase, ATP, or resource-pool dynamics.
Cell growth/dilution changes beyond fixed linear degradation.
Finite-time latency, observation/censoring cost, or switching energy.
Cell-cell transport or multicellular spatial communication.

falsifier_or_scope_check: For the stated model, solve the four-state flow equations or verify the constructed stationary chain. A biological application would require measuring the shared resource's effect on event intensities, verifying single-unit birth/death assumptions, and comparing a full-state LP policy against an equally informed controller subject to the same resource and sensing costs.
next_gate: Search exact two-output shared-cap controlled birth/death formulations; if no more specific prior subsumes the closed-form boundary, retain only as a narrow model lemma. For biology, augment the state by the limiting resource and controller species, then test whether the threshold LP predicts a measurable reliability tradeoff.
